title: Smaller PvP
description: A texture pack that makes swords smaller
body:
### Ever thought that the swords in the game were just too big for PvP?

Well, so did I, so I made this pack for you!

In this pack, swords have been retextured to look more like daggers, and am working on retexturing other items too!

Items needed for retexturing:
- Axes (yes people do axe pvp)
- Shield
- Buckets maybe? (eg. lava, water)
- Flint and Steel
- more I can't think of lolz
